title: Ask HN: Remove Filler LLM Comments
excerpt: Would HN consider removing the many filler LLM comments on this site if I pay $9/mo to only see real people posts?
content_html:
Would HN consider removing the many filler LLM comments on this site if I pay $9/mo to only see real people posts?

Nothing worse than getting an article for a product I just bought and seeing the comments full of talking points already - nobody cares that much about toothpaste!

Occasionally HN seems like it’s offline and I’m not talking to anyone but LLM generated comments.
